title: Add runtime-adjustable simulation speed controls (Faster/Slower) with tick interval readout

requirements.summary: Add Faster/Slower controls that halve/double the current simulation tick interval on each press.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI shows two new controls labeled in English (e.g., "Faster" and "Slower").
With the default tick interval at 500ms, pressing "Faster" once changes the interval to 250ms; pressing again changes it to 125ms.
Speed changes are applied immediately without requiring Reset or restarting the app.

file_operations.description: Replace the fixed TICK_INTERVAL constant with a tick interval state (default 500ms) and add two new UI controls labeled "Faster" and "Slower" that update the interval by halving/doubling respectively on each press. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for the new controls (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).

requirements.summary: Update the simulation loop to use a runtime-changeable tick interval without breaking Start/Pause/Reset or generation counting.
acceptanceCriteria: When the simulation is running, changing speed affects how frequently generations advance (faster/slower) without freezing or resetting the grid.
When the simulation is paused, changing speed does not advance generations; after pressing Start again, the new speed is used.
Reset still stops the simulation (paused state) and resets the generation counter to 0, regardless of the current speed setting.
Generation count increments by exactly 1 per simulation tick (no skipped or double-counted generations due to speed changes).

file_operations.description: Refactor the requestAnimationFrame-based simulation loop to reference the current tick interval at runtime (e.g., via a ref synced with state) so speed changes take effect immediately while running and are preserved while paused. Ensure Start/Pause/Reset behavior stays intact and that exactly one generation increment occurs per tick decision.

requirements.summary: Show a live English readout of the current tick interval in the controls panel.
acceptanceCriteria: The controls panel shows the current speed readout (e.g., "Tick: 0.50s" or "Interval: 500 ms").
The readout updates immediately after pressing "Faster" or "Slower".

file_operations.description: Add an English speed readout to the existing controls panel (e.g., "Interval: 500 ms" or "Tick: 0.50 s") that is derived from the tick interval state and updates immediately when Faster/Slower is pressed.
